integrity: The proof is analytic. The one-step drift, Lyapunov inequality, support exclusion and logarithmic martingale argument are stated explicitly; no finite simulation is used as a proof of the infinite-time claim.
scientific_limitations: The result covers only the specified with-replacement two-draw rule, at least three colours, and positive initial counts for every colour. It proves almost-sure convergence but gives no convergence rate, central limit theorem, or limiting fluctuation law. Other non-balanced multicolour reinforcement rules are not classified.
title: Uniform limits for a duplicate-suppressed multicolour urn
